name: MIRAGE syndrome
aliases: Myelodysplasia, Infection, Restriction of growth, Adrenal hypoplasia, Genital phenotypes, and Enteropathy syndrome

criteria.description: Congenital adrenal hypoplasia causing primary adrenal insufficiency
Myelodysplastic syndrome or bone marrow failure
Severe intrauterine growth restriction and postnatal growth failure
Chronic enteropathy with malabsorption and diarrhea
Genital abnormalities including ambiguous genitalia or hypogonadism
Recurrent severe infections due to immunodeficiency

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital adrenal hypoplasia, myelodysplasia, and growth restriction with supportive clinical features and confirmed pathogenic SAMD9 mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation of SAMD9 mutation is essential for definitive diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Primary adrenal hypoplasia with adrenal insufficiency
searchTerms: underdeveloped adrenal glands with hormone deficiency
adrenal gland failure causing low hormone levels
adrenal insufficiency from small adrenal glands

pathognomonic.symptomName: Myelodysplastic syndrome or bone marrow failure

common.symptomName: Chronic enteropathy with malabsorption and diarrhea
searchTerms: chronic gut inflammation with poor nutrient absorption
intestinal disease with malabsorption and loose stools

common.symptomName: Recurrent severe infections due to immunodeficiency
searchTerms: frequent serious infections due to weak immunity

common.symptomName: Genital abnormalities including ambiguous genitalia or hypogonadism

searchTerms: inability to gain weight or grow
failure to gain weight as infant

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary infections leading to respiratory distress
searchTerms: repeated chest infections with respiratory distress

rare.symptomName: Cardiovascular anomalies such as septal defects

laboratory: Pancytopenia or cytopenias on complete blood count
Elevated ACTH with low cortisol levels
Malabsorption markers such as low albumin and nutrient deficiencies
imaging: Adrenal hypoplasia on abdominal ultrasound or MRI
other: Histopathology of adrenal gland showing hypoplasia
Endoscopic biopsy of intestinal mucosa showing enteropathy

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated adrenal hypoplasia without myelodysplasia or growth restriction
Bone marrow failure without adrenal insufficiency

redFlags: Neonatal adrenal crisis with electrolyte imbalance
Progressive bone marrow failure with cytopenias
Severe failure to thrive with chronic diarrhea and malabsorption
references: Narumi S, et al. MIRAGE syndrome is caused by mutations in SAMD9, encoding a novel regulator of cell proliferation. Nat Genet. 2016.
Foster AC, et al. Clinical and molecular characterization of MIRAGE syndrome. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2019.
